B8.program: exists a, b, c on a line (<= 0.004): a.shape == b.shape != c.shape and c between a and b

B5.program: exists a, b, c: centroids collinear (height over the longest side <= 0.004); which shape is in the middle is random

B6.program: exists a, b: a.shape == b.shape != circle, same handedness, (a.rot - b.rot) mod (360/a.symmetry) == 0

B7.program: exists a, b: a.shape == b.shape, chiral, a.mirror != b.mirror  (roles share size: mirror images)
B7.knob: rotation phi between the two shapes (degrees; vertical-axis mirror in the positive)

B8.program: exists a, b, c on a line (<= 0.004): a.shape == b.shape != c.shape and c between a and b
B8.knob: gap between neighbouring shapes (centre spacing minus both circumradii)

B9.program: the closest pair of objects (centroid distance) has the same shape
B9.knob: ratio of the second-smallest to the smallest pairwise centroid distance

C2b.knob: circle count pair (4 vs 3) at a fixed total of 5-6 shapes

A3.program: exists o: o.size >= 0.11  (perimeter-equivalent radius; all other shapes below 0.11 - g)
A3.knob: size gap g to the 0.11 threshold (positive 0.11 + g, twin 0.11 - g)

A4.program: exists o: o.shape != circle and tilt(o) >= 10 deg, tilt = angular distance of o.rotation to the nearest multiple of 360/symmetry_order (every other non-circular shape is upright)
A4.knob: angle distance of the target's tilt from 45 deg (twin: upright)

A5.knob: concavity depth of the cross or L (panel widths, set through its size)

B5.program: exists a, b, c: centroids collinear (height over the longest side <= 0.004); which shape is in the middle is random
B5.knob: deviation of the middle shape from the line in the twin

B6.program: exists a, b: a.shape == b.shape != circle, same handedness, (a.rot - b.rot) mod (360/a.symmetry) == 0
B6.knob: orientation difference in the twin (degrees, modulo symmetry)

B7.program: exists a, b: a.shape == b.shape, chiral, a.mirror != b.mirror  (roles share size: mirror images)
B7.knob: rotation phi between the two shapes (degrees; vertical-axis mirror in the positive)

B8.program: exists a, b, c on a line (<= 0.004): a.shape == b.shape != c.shape and c between a and b
B8.knob: gap between neighbouring shapes (centre spacing minus both circumradii)

B9.program: the closest pair of objects (centroid distance) has the same shape
B9.knob: ratio of the second-smallest to the smallest pairwise centroid distance

C2b.program: count(o: o.shape == circle) == 4  (total count fixed within each twin pair)
C2b.knob: circle count pair (4 vs 3) at a fixed total of 5-6 shapes

C3b.program: count(o: o.shape == square) == 5  (total count fixed within each twin pair)
C3b.knob: square count pair (5 vs 4) at a fixed total of 6 shapes

C4b.program: count(o: o.shape == circle and o.fill == filled) == 2  (3 filled circles or pentagons; twin keeps fill count, ink)
C4b.knob: number of shapes in the panel (4-6; 3 of them filled)
